panels.title: Usage · last 5 h
panels.description: Cost (cost_usd) per Claude account over the last 5 hours. Bar = that cost as % of the account's peak: its highest rolling 5-hour cost over the last 30 days (10-minute steps). Green below 60 %, yellow from 60 %, red from 80 %. Fixed windows: ignores the dashboard time range and the variables. Accounts with no cost in 7 days are not listed.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    concat(if(t.label = '', '(no account)', t.label), '  ·  $', toString(round(t.h5, 2))) AS name,
    round(100 * t.h5 / greatest(p.peak, t.h5, 0.000001)) AS pct
FROM
(
    SELECT account_uuid,
           argMax(account, ts) AS label,
           sumIf(cost_usd, ts >= now() - INTERVAL 5 HOUR) AS h5,
           sumIf(cost_usd, ts >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS d7
    FROM cc.api_requests
    WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
    GROUP BY account_uuid
) AS t
LEFT JOIN
(
    SELECT account_uuid, max(w) AS peak
    FROM
    (
        SELECT account_uuid,
               sum(c) OVER (PARTITION BY account_uuid ORDER BY b RANGE BETWEEN 17999 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS w
        FROM
        (
            SELECT account_uuid, toUInt32(toStartOfInterval(ts, INTERVAL 10 MINUTE)) AS b, sum(cost_usd) AS c
            FROM cc.api_requests
            WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
            GROUP BY account_uuid, b
        )
    )
    GROUP BY account_uuid
) AS p ON p.account_uuid = t.account_uuid
WHERE t.d7 > 0
ORDER BY t.h5 DESC, t.d7 DESC

panels.title: Tips · 7 d
panels.description: Number of tips (view cc.tips, last 7 days). Click the value to open the Tips dashboard. Ignores the dashboard time range and the variables.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count() AS tips
FROM cc.tips

panels.description: The most frequent tip category (view cc.tips, last 7 days) with its count in brackets (ties: alphabetical order). Click the value to open the Tips dashboard. Ignores the dashboard time range and the variables.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT if(tips = 0, 'none', concat(multiIf(top = 'cache', 'Cache rebuilds', top = 'repeated-read', 'Repeated reads', top = 'big-results', 'Big tool results', top = 'short-opus', 'Short Opus answers', top = 'agent-outlier', 'Costly agent run', top = 'denials', 'Denied tool calls', top = 'slow-hook', 'Slow hooks', top = 'slow-ttft', 'Slow first token', top), ' (', toString(n), ')')) AS most_frequent
FROM
(
    SELECT sum(c) AS tips,
           argMin(category, (-toInt64(c), category)) AS top,
           max(c) AS n
    FROM (SELECT category, count() AS c FROM cc.tips GROUP BY category)
)

SELECT hook_name, count() AS runs, round(sum(hook_duration_ms) / 1000, 1) AS total_s,
       round(avg(hook_duration_ms)) AS avg_ms
FROM cc.events WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND event = 'hook_execution_complete'
GROUP BY hook_name ORDER BY total_s DESC

panels.title: API latency by model
panels.description: Per model: time to first token (ttft_ms, streaming requests only) and total request time (duration_ms), median and 95th percentile.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT model, count() AS requests,
       round(quantileIf(0.5)(ttft_ms, ttft_ms > 0)) AS ttft_p50_ms, round(quantileIf(0.95)(ttft_ms, ttft_ms > 0)) AS ttft_p95_ms,
       round(quantile(0.5)(duration_ms)) AS duration_p50_ms, round(quantile(0.95)(duration_ms)) AS duration_p95_ms
FROM (
  SELECT e.ts AS ts, e.account_uuid AS account_uuid, e.project AS project, e.session_id AS session_id, e.skill_name AS skill, e.model AS model, e.ttft_ms AS ttft_ms, e.duration_ms AS duration_ms,
         multiIf(e.agent_id != '', if(a.agent = '', 'agent?', a.agent), e.query_source IN ('sdk', 'main') OR startsWith(e.query_source, 'repl_main'), 'main', concat('aux:', e.query_source)) AS actor
  FROM cc.events AS e LEFT JOIN cc.agents AS a ON a.agent_id = e.agent_id
  WHERE e.event = 'api_request'
)
WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts)
GROUP BY model ORDER BY requests DESC

panels.title: Time to first token by day (p50 / p95)
panels.description: ttft_ms per day, all models; requests without ttft_ms are skipped.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfDay(ts) AS time, round(quantile(0.5)(ttft_ms)) AS p50, round(quantile(0.95)(ttft_ms)) AS p95
FROM (
  SELECT e.ts AS ts, e.account_uuid AS account_uuid, e.project AS project, e.session_id AS session_id, e.skill_name AS skill, e.ttft_ms AS ttft_ms,
         multiIf(e.agent_id != '', if(a.agent = '', 'agent?', a.agent), e.query_source IN ('sdk', 'main') OR startsWith(e.query_source, 'repl_main'), 'main', concat('aux:', e.query_source)) AS actor
  FROM cc.events AS e LEFT JOIN cc.agents AS a ON a.agent_id = e.agent_id
  WHERE e.event = 'api_request' AND e.ttft_ms > 0
)
WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts)
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Request duration by day (p50 / p95)
panels.description: duration_ms of API requests per day, all models.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfDay(ts) AS time, round(quantile(0.5)(duration_ms)) AS p50, round(quantile(0.95)(duration_ms)) AS p95
FROM cc.api_requests WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts)
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Tool duration and errors
panels.description: Per tool: calls, duration (avg / p50 / p95) and failed calls (success = false).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT tool_name, count() AS calls, round(avg(duration_ms)) AS avg_ms,
       round(quantile(0.5)(duration_ms)) AS p50_ms, round(quantile(0.95)(duration_ms)) AS p95_ms,
       countIf(NOT success) AS errors, round(100 * countIf(NOT success) / count(), 1) AS error_pct
FROM cc.tool_calls WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts)
GROUP BY tool_name ORDER BY p95_ms DESC

panels.title: Tool errors by day
panels.description: Failed tool calls (success = false) per day and tool.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfDay(ts) AS time, tool_name, count() AS errors
FROM cc.tool_calls WHERE NOT success AND ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts)
GROUP BY time, tool_name ORDER BY time

panels.title: Recent failed tool calls
panels.description: Latest 50 failed tool calls (no paths or commands shown).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ts, tool_name, actor, project, session_id, duration_ms
FROM cc.tool_calls WHERE NOT success AND ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts)
